# 0. Setup

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

rm(list = ls())
options(
  mc.cores = parallel::detectCores(),
  styler.addins_style_transformer = styler::tidyverse_style(indent_by = 4)
)

set.seed(2026) 
rstan_options(auto_write = TRUE)

lintr::use_lintr(type = "tidyverse")
lintr::lint_dir()
lintr::lint(filename = "R/bad.R")

#source(file = "")

chosen_colors <- list(dark_blue = "#272774",
                      light_blue = "#4182FF",
                      pink = "#EBC4B4",
                      purple = "#B880FF",
                      yellow= "#FFDD77",
                      green = "#7DDE88")


```

# 1. Introduction

```{r}
data <- read.csv("../01_Data/parkinsons_updrs.data")

head(data)

summary(data %>%   select(total_UPDRS, motor_UPDRS))

4*4
```


# 2. Analysis

## 2.1 Descriptive Analysis
```{r}
data %>% 
  filter(subject.==1)%>%
  ggplot(aes(x = test_time, y=total_UPDRS))+
  geom_point()+  
  geom_line()+  
  labs(x = "Test time",
       y = "Total UPDRS",
       title = "Total UPDRS at different timepoints",
       subtitle = "Suject 1") +
  theme_bw()

data %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = test_time, y = total_UPDRS, 
             colour = factor(subject.),
             group = subject.)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(colour = "Subject",
       x = "Test time",
       y = "Total UPDRS",
       title = "Total UPDRS at different timepoints",
       subtitle = "All subjects") +
  theme_bw()
```
# 2.2.1 Treating Timepoints

```{r}
data%>%
  distinct(test_time)%>%
  summary()
```

```{r}
data %>%
  summarise(`number of distinct timepoints` = n_distinct(test_time))
```
Negative timepoints
```{r}
data%>%
  filter(test_time <0)%>%
  select(`subjects with negative timepoints` = subject.)%>%
  distinct()
```
We only have 2 subjects with 
```{r}
data%>%
  filter(subject. %in% c(34, 42))%>%
  select(subject., test_time, total_UPDRS)%>%
    ggplot(aes(x = test_time, y = total_UPDRS, 
             colour = factor(subject.),
             group = subject.)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_line() +
  labs(colour = "Subject",
       x = "Test time",
       y = "Total UPDRS",
       title = "Total UPDRS at different timepoints",
       subtitle = "Subjects with timepoints < 0") +
  theme_bw()
```
We can probably just remove the negative timepoints as nothing too alarming elsewhere?

```{r}
timepoints_per_patient <- data %>%
  group_by(subject.) %>%
  summarise(
    n_timepoints = n_distinct(test_time),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```


```{r}
summary(timepoints_per_patient%>% select(n_timepoints))
```



```{r}
ggplot(timepoints_per_patient,
       aes(x = n_timepoints)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    x = "Number of timepoints per patient",
    y = "Number of patients"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
```{r}
timepoints_per_patient %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_col(aes(x = subject., y=n_timepoints), 
           fill=chosen_colors$pink) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = mean(timepoints_per_patient$n_timepoints),
    linetype = "dashed",
    colour = chosen_colors$light_blue,
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Patient",
    y = "Number of timepoints",
    title = "Number of timepoints for each patient",
    subtitle = paste(
      "Mean number of timepoints:",
      round(mean(timepoints_per_patient$n_timepoints), 2)
    )
  ) +  theme_bw()
```
